title: F. Interesting Sections
statement:
William has an array of non-negative numbers a_1, a_2, …, a_n. He wants you to find out how many segments l ≤ r pass the check. The check is performed in the following manner:

The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6), the size of array a.

The second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^18), the contents of array a.

Output a single number — the total number of segments that passed the check.

Input:
```
5
1 2 3 4 5
```

Output:
```
9
```

Input:
```
10
0 5 7 3 9 10 1 6 13 7
```

Output:
```
18
```
input:
The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6), the size of array a.

The second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^18), the contents of array a.
output: Output a single number — the total number of segments that passed the check.
